description: This file declares APIs and functions related to PowerManagement configuration, including getting, setting, validating, committing, and rolling back power management parameters in a software project.

methods.name: PowerManagement_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter value for power management.

methods.name: PowerManagement_SetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Sets a boolean parameter value for power management.

methods.name: PowerManagement_Validate
methods.description: Validates power management parameters before committing changes.

methods.name: PowerManagement_Commit
methods.description: Commits changes to power management configuration.

methods.name: PowerManagement_Rollback
methods.description: Rolls back any uncommitted changes to power management configuration.
